name: Strat, bridge + middle (DI, for the amps)
_notes: Evolution Stratosphere 1.3.5: Channel-Based Strings = MIDI Guitar (channel 1 = high e), Guitar Pickup Bridge + Middle (locked in this version), stomp boxes off: the dry pickup signal (DI) that the Archetypes re-amp. Velocity is the only articulation control by default (half / full palm mute, mute, squeal are unmapped on PLAY): those need keyswitches mapped later. pace 0.5: Kontakt streams from disk in real time, so the render waits half the note length after each note (a full-speed render left 60% of notes silent).
